source_title: Pick of the stats: Middlesbrough v Charlton Athletic - BBC
source_excerpt:
Middlesbrough will aim to at least maintain their two-point lead at the top of the Championship when they host free-falling Charlton on Saturday (15:00 GMT).
Boro's 5-1 win at Bolton took them top before defeats for closest challengers Swansea and West Ham but they return to the Riverside where they have won only one of their past three games.
The Addicks are 19th after taking just one point from their past four away games and are now winless in nine league games overall, failing to score in four of them.
Middlesbrough have won 10 of their past 14 league games against Charlton Athletic (D2 L2), keeping six clean sheets across the past 10.
